transcription.text:
SKILLET CORNBREAD WITH HONEY BUTTER
Serves 8

This is our Sunday cornbread. It goes in a screaming-hot
cast-iron skillet so the edges come out crisp.

INGREDIENTS

For the cornbread
1 1/2 cups (210 g) yellow cornmeal
1 cup (125 g) all-purpose flour
2 tablespoons sugar
1 tablespoon baking powder
1 teaspoon fine salt
2 large eggs
1 1/2 cups (360 ml) buttermilk
6 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted, divided

For the honey butter
1/2 cup (113 g) unsalted butter, softened
3 tablespoons honey
Pinch of flaky salt

METHOD

1. Put a 10-inch cast-iron skillet in the oven and heat
the oven to 425F with the skillet inside, about 15 minutes.

2. Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and
salt in a large bowl.

3. In another bowl, whisk the eggs and buttermilk, then
whisk in 4 tablespoons of the melted butter.

4. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir just
until combined. Do not overmix; a few lumps are fine.

5. Carefully take the hot skillet out, add the remaining
2 tablespoons of butter and swirl to coat. Pour in the
batter; it should sizzle.

6. Bake 20 to 25 minutes, until golden and a toothpick
in the center comes out clean.

7. While it bakes, beat the softened butter, honey and
flaky salt until fluffy.

8. Cool the cornbread 10 minutes in the skillet, then
cut into wedges and serve with the honey butter.
